Make a Poem a Poem by giving that experience extra layers which work on the page and invite others in #smallpoems #foolingwithwords Found poem from Deborah Garrison
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Strange
where do lines come
from?
Pull back from where
you are, lost in
mire
describe the
world
and
lift yourself out.
Turn the experience into art.
Make a Poem a Poem
by giving that experience
extra layers which
  work on the page
and invite others in
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
Found poem from Deborah Garrison
